dossier.architecture: Compact pivoting telescope and wristed roller end effector on swerve.

subsystems.intake: Dead-axle rollers acquire both pieces; different poses cover upright cones, tipped cones, floor cubes and shelf loading.
subsystems.transfer: Direct end-effector acquisition with no separate magazine.
subsystems.scoring: Two-stage telescoping arm, shoulder pivot and wrist provide reach while keeping the stowed package low.
subsystems.endgame: Interview describes three-piece autonomous plus balance; no special station attachment is established here.
subsystems.controls: Tuned joint controllers, selectable piece/level presets, home/brake setup buttons and modular waypoint-to-waypoint autonomous sequences.

versions: Multiple end-effector iterations reported; individual shapes not all distinguished.
Public release adds CAD and technical binder references for further inspection.
dossier.analysis: The transferable lesson is coordinated reach and rapid autonomous iteration. Their extended acquisition reach reduces chassis travel, but depends on accurate joints and consistent homing.
limits: Full season timeline and endgame attachment status require corroboration.

context_documents.title: 2023-2910 · A compact telescoping package still needs piece-specific poses
context_documents.body:
# 2023-2910: A compact telescoping package still needs piece-specific poses

Focused study supplement. Not a full binder/CAD review, exhaustive subsystem specification, every-version history or visual interview watch.

## Published / retained construction account

A two-stage telescoping arm, shoulder and wrist provide grid reach while stowing low. The source demonstrates distinct floor-cube, tipped-cone, upright-cone and shelf-acquisition poses using dead-axis roller contacts.

## Team-stated reasoning or boundary

The stated objectives are speed, compactness, all-level reach and low center of gravity.

## Engineering interpretation — analyst inference

One gripper does not imply one acquisition state. The arm and wrist jointly create the contact conditions for each piece, while extension changes torque and clearance. A copied roller layout without those poses and transitions is incomplete.

## Proposed validation — not performed

Validate every acquisition pose and the connecting paths, then measure loaded settle time at maximum reach.

## Limits

Focused technical passages and the retained dossier are the evidence scope. Exact event installation, complete CAD tolerances and all intermediate revisions are not certified.

## Sources and navigation

- [https://youtu.be/7ETEf__nD1I](https://youtu.be/7ETEf__nD1I)
- [https://www.chiefdelphi.com/t/436653](https://www.chiefdelphi.com/t/436653)

source_reviews.title: 2910 Phantom CAD and tech binder release
source_reviews.review_basis: Read the team-authored posts and technical replies at these locators.
source_reviews.facts: Team confirms internal Falcon encoders, tight-fitting REV ION gears, dead-axle main pivot, delayed extension near shoulder setpoint, and cone centering using intake-wall time-of-flight measurement. Two angled cameras relocalized during teleop. Release checked X, Y, yaw and pitch. Manual scoring could be faster.
source_reviews.limitations: Linked Dropbox binder returned an error. Team qualitative comments establish intended behavior, with no independent timing or accuracy distribution.

source_reviews.title: 2910 interview
source_reviews.review_basis: Inherited synopsis. No fresh full-caption or visual review.
source_reviews.facts: Older interview describes compact pivoting two-stage telescope, wristed direct roller tool, floor and shelf poses, and MK4i swerve.
source_reviews.limitations: Treat specific details and configuration dates as provisional.

source_reviews.title: 2910 DefaultDriveCommand.java
source_reviews.locator: Field-relative velocity transform and offset telemetry, blob d50bec33b7929f75a5eb3019a9405c28353891e7
source_reviews.review_basis: Read team-published Java and team code-release posts 3, 6 and 7.
source_reviews.facts: The code adds angular velocity times a fixed coefficient to the heading used for the field-relative transform. Team says the compensation reduced translation direction error while rotating. The release discussion also documents recharacterizing path feedforward after three gearing changes.
source_reviews.limitations: The default drive command is a separate implementation from cone scoring alignment. The gain is tuned to that chassis and version.

source_review.whole_robot_explanation: Phantom uses a compact telescoping arm to reach a piece at the floor or shelf and carry it directly to the grid. The team documented a useful tradeoff between moving joints together and staying stable. Extending early increased tip tendency, so extension waits until the shoulder is near its target. The team also measured where the cone sat within the gripper so automatic alignment aimed the piece at the node instead of assuming it was centered on the chassis.
piece_flow: Select the source posture and acquire the piece with the wristed roller tool. The older account lists several floor and shelf poses.
Keep the piece in the tool as the shoulder moves. In the team-described stability sequence, delay extension until the shoulder is within an allowed distance of its target.
During assisted cone scoring, use the measured cone offset and localized chassis pose to select a scoring column. The driver advances to confirm. Release when position and orientation checks pass.
source_review.packaging_and_motion: A telescope allows a compact stow and significant loaded reach. The worst overturning moment can occur during transition when the arm is extended at an unfavorable angle. Deferring extension reduces that moment at the expense of overlap. Tight gear fits and a stiff A-frame let the team use motor-side encoders, which still require a consistent reference and minimal lost motion at the tool.

subsystems.name: Shoulder and telescope
subsystems.construction: Team confirms dead-axle main pivot, stiff A-frame, REV ION gear fits and internal Falcon encoders. The older dossier identifies a two-stage telescope.
subsystems.operation: Rotate shoulder, extend and adjust wrist. Team reports sequencing extension based on shoulder progress.
subsystems.team_rationale: Team explicitly addresses tipping and mechanical backlash.
subsystems.engineering_analysis: Measure loaded tip error from both motion directions and quantify wheel unloading with a piece while braking. Motor position can be accurate even while a compliant joint moves.
subsystems.interfaces: The shoulder-to-extension gate determines how much mass moves forward during rotation.
subsystems.service_and_failure_modes: Check startup reference, tension and backlash after maintenance. Test a missed gate and a stalled intermediate posture.
subsystems.unknowns: Actual gating threshold, current limits and observed wheel loads.

subsystems.name: Roller tool and offset sensing
subsystems.construction: Older account describes dead-axle roller contacts. Team confirms a time-of-flight sensor inside the intake wall.
subsystems.operation: Capture and retain both pieces. For cone alignment, estimate its lateral position inside the tool.
subsystems.team_rationale: Team says an off-center cone could miss when aligned using the drivebase center alone.
subsystems.engineering_analysis: Measure sensor error across cone orientation, surface condition and partial seating. Center measurement is useful only when it predicts the cone's placement contact.
subsystems.interfaces: Tool offset measurement feeds node selection and lateral chassis control.
subsystems.service_and_failure_modes: Test dirty optics, no-return values and side-seated cones. Manual release needs predictable behavior if automated checks are unavailable.
subsystems.unknowns: Sensor calibration, mounting tolerances and cube behavior.

subsystems.name: Chassis alignment
subsystems.construction: Team describes two angled cameras for relocalization and a release gate across X, Y, yaw and pitch.
subsystems.operation: Close the lateral and angular error, then let the driver's forward command confirm the approach.
subsystems.team_rationale: Team reports strict thresholds cut false positives and sometimes made manual scoring faster.
subsystems.engineering_analysis: Compare both workflows on full scoring time and misses, including reacquisition after a rejected gate.
subsystems.interfaces: Localization and in-tool measurement must share the same coordinate conventions.
subsystems.service_and_failure_modes: Check camera calibration and degraded-field visibility. Test manual field-relative driving at varied turn rates after any drivetrain change because the published compensation coefficient was tuned empirically.
subsystems.unknowns: Exact threshold settings, timeouts and configuration dates.

revisions: Older record describes several tool prototypes. Team describes automatic scoring late in the season and release publications afterward.
The code-release Q&A reports three drivetrain gearings and a shift from concatenating PathPlanner segments to independent trajectories.
transferable_principles: Measure the piece in the tool when centering error is comparable to target tolerance. Sequence axes against the loaded stability envelope.
disconfirming_conditions: Automatic release loses value when conservative thresholds cost more cycles than they save. Motor-only sensing becomes inadequate when wear or deflection exceeds placement tolerance.
remaining_gaps: Binder access, full captions, source inspection of arm and alignment logic, and event-specific threshold history.
recommended_images: Team release robot render and a close-up showing the intake-wall sensor relative to a loaded cone.
